note: What a server sends to open a surrender vote, or to report one already open.

bits.name: countAsYes
bits.note: Set where the receiving seat is taken to have voted for.

bits.name: openTheMenu
bits.note: Set where the client shows the vote to the seat.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A server leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.

fields.name: caller
fields.note: The unit that called the vote.

fields.name: closesIn
fields.note: How long the vote stays open, in seconds.
